predictor.notes: Affine baseline for quantities 1..1000, not an exact reconstruction of the hidden rule. Observed exact prices were 52,491 cents at quantity 50 and 82,784 cents at quantity 200; approved quotes and exports agreed across the two sessions. This predictor reproduces both anchors exactly after rounding. Estimate/alias probes and probes for additional approvals were denied, consistent with the application's stated restrictions. Used 24 attempted business requests and 3 REA operations. Prices at the other 998 quantities remain unobserved. Curvature and band transitions are not identifiable: adding ±0.1*(q-50)*(q-200) preserves both anchors but changes the prediction at 1000 by ±76,000 cents. Thus interpolation and extrapolation are unvalidated, with no defensible global error bound.
